skills.name: Transitrix ADR
skills.description: Help a user formulate an architecture decision and land it as a valid, gated Architecture Decision Record in the repo's per-repo decision log — the input door to the agent-authored decision flow method/07-decisions.md specifies but ships no workflow for. Runs a Context → Decision → Consequences interview, derives the id from today's date and a slug (no allocation step), validates against scripts/check-adl.mjs, and opens a PR. Never self-accepts a decision and never edits an accepted record's body — course changes are a new record plus a status-pointer flip on the old one (supersession).
headings: The three invariants this skill enforces
Step 0 — Locate (or scaffold) the decisions folder
Step 1 — Is this actually a decision?
Step 3 — Derive the id, write the record
Step 4 — Mark promotable, if the Step 2 scope check said cross-repo candidate
Step 6 — Supersede an existing decision (course change)
What this skill does NOT do
skills.description_zh: 通过背景—决策—后果访谈编写 Transitrix 架构决策记录，用当日日期和短名称生成 ID，运行 scripts/check-adl.mjs 校验并创建 PR。不会自行批准或改写已接受记录正文，方向变化以新记录和旧记录状态指针表达。

skills.name: Transitrix Feedback
skills.description: Author an upstream methodology-directed finding as a gated, anonymised entry in the repo's own operations/feedback.md register — the input door to the upstream feedback channel method/06-team-operations.md §3.2 specifies but ships no workflow for. Routes non-methodology observations away first, runs an interview, composes and shows the scrubbed wording for confirmation before writing, allocates the next FB-NNNN, and (on request only) renders a ready-to-send message for hello@transitrix.com without ever transmitting it itself.
headings: The three invariants this skill enforces
Step 1 — Route: is this actually a methodology-directed finding?
Step 5 — Update status on a later invocation
Step 6 — Land the change: PR, not merge
What this skill does NOT do
skills.description_zh: 在仓库 operations/feedback.md 中整理面向 Transitrix 方法论的匿名反馈，先过滤非方法问题、访谈并展示清理后的措辞，经确认后写入并分配 FB-NNNN。仅按要求生成待发送邮件文字，不实际发送。

skills.name: Transitrix Adoption Health Profile
skills.description: Measure how effectively a Transitrix adoption is working in practice. Computes five instrumental indicators (validity, coverage, freshness, assertion-queue age/drain, connectedness) over a repository's model files. Each indicator is sourced from two independent records; the measure cannot be faked without doing the work. Produces a markdown report showing the denominator (file classification), all five indicators with both readings, and the honest blind spot count.
skills.name_hint: Transitrix · Adoption · 健康状态 · Profile
skills.description_zh: 衡量 Transitrix 实际采用效果，对仓库模型文件计算有效性、覆盖、时效、断言队列年龄及消化、连通性五类指标，每项以两份独立记录核对，并输出含文件分类分母、两种读数和盲点数量的 Markdown 报告。

skills.name: Transitrix Ingest
skills.description: Turn raw organisational material (interviews, policies, org charts, spreadsheets, notes) into Transitrix field artefacts and typed canon candidates at scale, with source-quality scoring and a human review queue. Also set up catalogue federation and prepare recognition or promotion proposals for human review. Never writes canon directly.
headings: The one rule that governs everything
or, once the package is published to npm:
Step 2 — Convert the source to Markdown
Step 3 — Emit the field artefact (with proposed source_quality)
Two axes of trust — never merge them
skills.description_zh: 将访谈、政策、组织图、表格和笔记转为 Transitrix 现场资料及带类型的规范候选项，进行来源质量评分并进入人工审查队列。也支持目录联邦及识别／提升建议，不直接写入正式规范。

skills.name: Transitrix Knowledge Store
skills.description: Ingest raw source material into the OKF single-repo MVP knowledge store — assess, archive, route to the OKF track (extract drafts → verify → human review → promote to knowledge/) and/or the Canon track (extract Transitrix primitives → PR to canon/), and log every decision.
headings: 5c — Log assertion outcome (after PR is merged or closed)
skills.description_zh: 把原始资料纳入 OKF 单仓库 MVP 知识库，评估归档后路由到 OKF 的草稿提取—验证—人工审查—提升至 knowledge/ 流程，或 Transitrix 原语提取—提交 canon/ PR 流程，并记录每项决策。

skills.name: Transitrix Onboarding
skills.description: Scaffold a new Transitrix architecture-as-text repository (zoned canon/ + field/ + codex/ layout with assistant-neutral AGENTS.md + transitrix.yaml manifest) and drive a first modelling session — enterprise architecture (BPMN, DGCA / Goals, capability map, process blueprint, action schedule, actions tree, nested blocks, scenarios, products, applications) plus codex artefacts (laws, regulations, policies, internal standards). Use when the user wants to start a new Transitrix repo from scratch, or has just cloned one and wants to author their first notation file with validation.
headings: Step 1 — Detect repo state and branch
Greenfield — confirm intent and surface area
Drop in the canonical root files
Suggest editor tooling — right after scaffolding, don't wait for Step 5
Admission record and lifecycle — you compute these, the user doesn't hand-type them
_intake/ — the ingest skill's operational workspace (scaffolded later by
`transitrix-ingest scaffold-intake`). It is a PER-USER, PRIVATE area: its
contents are NOT shared with other modellers, so nothing that participates in
the model may live there. Ignore the working files, but commit a .gitkeep in
each subfolder so the inbox/ → processing/ → processed/ skeleton persists for
Step 3 — Create the starter notation file from a template
skills.description_zh: 初始化 Transitrix 文本化架构仓库，建立 canon/、field/、codex/ 分区、通用 AGENTS.md 和 transitrix.yaml，并引导首次模型编写验证，涵盖企业流程、目标、能力、场景、产品应用及法律政策等资料。

skills.name: Transitrix Reg-Intel
skills.description: Collect regulatory-source changes in practice — the operational counterpart to the methodology's codex / SEGMENT / AMENDMENT notation work. Reads the centralised watch-list at `operations/config/scan-sources.yaml`, runs a cheap change-signal gate before any expensive extraction, then on signal-moved runs the SCAN → SEGMENT → CLASSIFY → OUTPUT pass: fetches and snapshots the source, slices it into obligation-bearing SEGMENT field artefacts, classifies each segment as a CONSTRAINT or REQUIREMENT candidate (positive obligation → REQUIREMENT by default), emits an AMENDMENT field artefact when an existing source has drifted, updates the codex `scan` block, and stages everything in a review digest for human admission. Never writes canon. Never auto-admits. Never silently drops.
headings: The two rules that govern everything
Step 3 — Fetch and snapshot (only if the signal moved)
Step 4 — SEGMENT (slice the source into obligation-bearing chunks)
Step 5 — CLASSIFY (CONSTRAINT vs REQUIREMENT, with the default rule)
Step 7 — AMENDMENT (when an existing source drifted)
Two axes of trust — never merged
Scope guards — what this skill does NOT do
skills.description_zh: 读取 operations/config/scan-sources.yaml 监管来源清单，先检测变化信号再抓取快照，分割承载义务的 SEGMENT 并分类为约束或需求候选，来源偏移时生成 AMENDMENT、更新扫描块并暂存审查摘要。仅供人工纳入，不直接写 canon 或自动批准。

skills.name: Transitrix Repo-Check
skills.description: Read-only health check ("doctor") for a Transitrix adopter repository. Emits a short, DATA-FREE report — methodology version, resolved coverage profile, per-zone and per-TYPE counts, an adoption-level indicator, integrity red flags (invalid IDs, misplaced canon elements, unresolved profile), and a tooling check. Reports aggregates and statuses only — never object ids, names, or contents — so the report is safe to share outside the organisation. Idempotent and non-mutating: it reads the zones and never writes one.
headings: or, once the package is published to npm:
skills.description_zh: 只读检查 Transitrix 仓库健康，汇总方法版本、覆盖配置、分区与类型数量、采用程度、ID及位置完整性和工具状态。报告仅含聚合及状态，不含对象ID、名称或内容，不修改仓库。

skills.name: Transitrix Report
skills.description: Produce a compliance report (obligation × subject impact matrix, or per-regime coverage metric) from a Transitrix repository, by conversation. Resolves the report's parameters — from the request, from the view spec's defaults, or from a named saved view-config — materialises a versioned view-config artefact, and renders it through the deterministic `@transitrix/cli export-compliance` command to Markdown or PDF. The skill never computes a matrix itself; rendering stays in the CLI so the same config re-renders identically next quarter. Reports are reproducible and auditable: every report has a committed parameter artefact, and the skill states which spec defaults it assumed.
headings: The one rule that governs everything
Step 3 — Return the report and its provenance
skills.description_zh: 通过对话确定 Transitrix 合规报告参数，保存版本化 view-config，再由 @transitrix/cli export-compliance 确定性生成 Markdown／PDF义务与主体影响矩阵或监管覆盖指标。明确采用的默认参数，保留可审计的参数产物供重复生成。

skills.name: Transitrix Status
skills.description: On-demand view of what is waiting behind every human gate in a Transitrix adopter repository — ADR proposed/accepted/superseded (author:agent broken out), Work Item phase, canon element status, REQUIREMENT/CONSTRAINT review-overdue, and ingest batches awaiting review. One table, phases and counts only (no ages, no thresholds), plus the ids in every open phase so the caller can act on them. Read-only — never writes a zone, an operations record, or a batch.
headings: or, once the package is published to npm:
skills.description_zh: 只读展示 Transitrix 各人工门槛后待处理事项，包括 ADR 状态、工作项阶段、规范元素、逾期需求约束审查及待审查导入批次。输出阶段、数量及开放阶段ID，不写入资料区或批次。
